title: Long-Coverage Months on a Revised Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility Arrangement
content:
Long-coverage months are added to the remaining term of a revised Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility arrangement according to the whole calendar months between the coverage record's effective date and the handling date.

| Whole calendar months since the coverage record's effective date | Months added |
|---|---|
| at least 120 | 2 |
| at least 60 but fewer than 120 | 1 |
| fewer than 60 | 0 |

Hypothetical records: effective 120 whole months ago adds 2; 119 months adds 1; 60 months adds 1; 59 months adds none.
